decisions.decision: Plugin interface: ABC with 4 methods (check_availability, auto_buy, login, detect_captcha); only first two abstract

decisions.decision: Plugin distribution: drop-in plugins/ folder + shopbot_plugin_*.py naming + GitHub wiki

decisions.decision: Concurrency: asyncio.TaskGroup + ThreadPoolExecutor, one driver per plugin
decisions.rationale: TaskGroup cancels siblings on failure; one driver per plugin avoids Selenium thread-safety issues
Typed validation at startup; actionable errors; requires Python 3.10+
asyncio.TaskGroup requires 3.11; pydantic-settings 2.x requires 3.10+; Python 3.8 EOL Oct 2024
